compatibility.local_nltk: Load punkt_tab and averaged_perceptron_tagger_eng only from the bundle's nltk_data; refuse downloads.
compatibility.engine_tools_only: ChatCompletionsApiModelHandler._build_optional_kwargs drops default tool_choice for empty tools and refuses nonempty tools.

compatibility.not_accepted: Real-model compatibility, licence inventory, frozen speech sets, device latency, memory and intelligibility remain release gates.
